evidence: We used a custom-built, warm-wall flow reactor for all ALD processing. The ALD reactor design was previously described and specifications were reported earlier. (Methylcyclopentadienyl)-trimethylplatinum (MeCpPtMe3) (Strem) and bis(cyclopentadienyl)ruthenium (Ru(Cp)2) (Strem) were used as the metal precursors for Pt ALD and Ru ALD, respectively. For both ALD processes, pure oxygen (Praxair) was used as a counter reactant, and nitrogen gas (99.9995%) was used as both a purging gas and a carrier gas.
